messages:
Jules (CSM): Heads up — Alcove (onboarding) is seeing p95 generation latency creep to ~420ms on /v1/generate in the last 24h. Low volume but consistent spikes. Thoughts on a low-risk perf tweak?
Maria (Account Lead): Noted. Alcove is in week 3 of onboarding, heavy doc ingestion flows. They mentioned possible churn if latency blocks demo flows. Agree we should be conservative.
Raj (Platform Eng): Quick signal from traces: majority of spike comes from long-context requests ~8k tokens. Memory pressure causes regen waits. We could try model swap to compact-int8 variant or route long requests to a dedicated pool.
Jules (CSM): Model swap sounds good if perf delta is meaningful. Do we have numbers for int8-compact-v1 vs baseline? Cost impact?
Raj (Platform Eng): From offline bench: baseline-std-v2 p95 ~410ms, int8-compact-v1 p95 ~220ms on same hw, token cost ~-30%. Quality delta small on our evals (token-level BLEU/ROUGE drop trivial for their prompt set).
Tim (Ops): Canary plan: 1) create route rule for alcove_account_id that sends 5% of traffic for requests >4k tokens to int8-compact-v1; 2) monitor latency, error rate, and semantic diffs on eval set; 3) auto-fallback to baseline if regressions exceed threshold. Can do rollout today in maintenance window.
Jules (CSM): Sounds safe. Maria — can you confirm Alcove is OK with a short canary and an enablement call to review outputs? We should capture their feedback on any subtle quality shifts.
Maria (Account Lead): I'll ping them now. Prefer avoid visible change during sales demos; schedule canary outside demo windows (they have demos Mon/Wed 10am PST). Also want a short FAQ for their product team explaining why outputs might look slightly different.
Raj (Platform Eng): I'll prepare route config snippet and diffing harness. Snippet:```json
{
  "route": "alcove-account-id",
  "match": {"request.tokens": ">4000"},
  "actions": [{"percent":5, "model":"int8-compact-v1"}, {"percent":95, "model":"baseline-std-v2"}]
}```
Tim (Ops): We'll wire EvalBot to run prompt set A/B for canary traffic and post semantic similarity scores. Set thresholds: mean sim >= 0.98 and no increase in hallucination flags.
EvalBot: Canary harness initialized. Will report latency, cost delta, and semantic sim every 15m to #customer-success (summary).
Jules (CSM): Action items: Raj - create route + canary config; Tim - schedule rollout window and hooks; Maria - confirm timings with Alcove and prep FAQ. I'll capture feedback thread and update renewal risk doc if they flag any UX concerns.
Maria (Account Lead): Confirmed — Alcove ok with canary Friday 18:00 UTC. I'll join enablement call and collect immediate feedback.
Tim (Ops): I'll kick off canary at that time, will send deploy-bot message and brief runbook. If errors >0.5% or p95 worsens, we'll revert.
Raj (Platform Eng): Deploy config pushed to staging. Will promote to canary target at time.
Jules (CSM): Thanks all — please drop short postmortem + customer notes in the thread after the run so we have the capture for renewal review. :thumbsup:
Maria (Account Lead): Will do.
Tim (Ops): Deploy-bot will post status updates. :rocket:
